test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 11 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Eight people, A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a straight line, facing north. Only three people sit to the left of A. B sits third to the right of A. Only four people sit between B and D. F sits to the immediate right of G. C does not sit at any of the extreme ends of the line. E sits at one of the positions to the right of H. How many people sit between H and A?
solution:
Given: Eight people, A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

1) Only three people sit to the left of A.

2) B sits third to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/386759eaa9bc62128e77780a31434e9f07146c75df248777b27aa2c7d60de01a.png] 

3) Only four people sit between B and D.
